description: The plot illustrates the ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, comparing the performance of different model configurations in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis is labeled with categorical values representing different model configurations, including "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", with no numerical scale or units. The y-axis is labeled as "Metric (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays three lines: a purple line representing precision, a blue line representing recall, and a brown line representing F1-score, all with solid line styles and circular markers. The precision line starts at 65.49 for the full model and ends at 65.44 for the "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" configuration, with values decreasing to 61.06 for "w/o Prompt" before increasing to 64.06 for "w/o Attention". The recall line begins at 65.78 for the full model, drops to 59.64 for "w/o Prompt", peaks at 62.63 for "w/o Augmentation", and then declines to 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The F1-score line starts at 65.56 for the full model, decreases to 60.16 for "w/o Prompt", reaches 63.7 for "w/o Augmentation", and ends at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
